name: Kanban
description: Obsidian Kanban's boards: a Markdown file with kanban-plugin in its frontmatter opens as lanes of cards you drag, tick, edit and archive, written back so Obsidian still reads it.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: Kanban boards are Markdown files with `kanban-plugin: board` (`vau docs kanban`): read one with `kanban_read`, add a card with `kanban_add`, move one with `kanban_move`; `kanban_list` lists them.
